counterevidence: A Hudson mailing address does not prove proposal selection.

conclusions: The exact Hudson proposal site remains unresolved.
All three Hudson-addressed entries should be searched in native records, with #209 prioritized but not promoted.
The proposal remains a rejected proposal, not a deployment.
counterarguments: The current directory is September 2026 evidence and cannot independently resolve an August-December 2025 proposal.
findings: Stewart’s current first-party Hudson directory lists Claverack #493 at 811 NY-66, Greenport #239 at 5805 Route 9G, and Hudson Rt 9 & Fairview Ave #209 at 13 Fairview Avenue.
Shop #209 is the only one of those three whose first-party store label itself is Hudson Rt 9 & Fairview Ave; it is a records-search priority, not proof of proposal selection.
Times Union reporting establishes that Hudson Police made a similar Stewart’s request in Columbia County and that Stewart’s rejected it, but does not identify the property.
